The '''Dream Emporium''' was an entertainment complex located within the primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]]. The business catered to the local [[Etti]]s and the wealthy members of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].
